title: Project document
description: Generated from the ove-core field registry. Do not edit by hand (cargo run -p ove-core --bin ove-schema).

order.description: Position; 0 is the top layer. Unique and contiguous.

locked.description: Locked tracks cannot be edited in the GUI.

data.description: type, fileName, format, size, duration, width, height, frameRate, hasAudio, statuses, …

nativePath.description: Absolute path of the file, or relative to the bundle when owned.

ownedByBundle.description: The file lives in the bundle's media/ folder.

size.description: Last known file size in bytes.

modifiedAt.description: Last known modification time, ms since the epoch.

trackId.description: Id of the track the item is on.

trimStart.description: Seconds trimmed from the start of the source.

trimEnd.description: Seconds trimmed from the end of the source.

mediaItemId.description: Id of the media item the item plays.

pending.description: Placeholder awaiting generated or supplied media.

pendingDescription.description: What the pending placeholder should become.

x.description: Horizontal offset in pixels from the frame centre.

y.description: Vertical offset in pixels from the frame centre.

top.description: Percent of height removed from the top.

right.description: Percent of width removed from the right.

bottom.description: Percent of height removed from the bottom.

left.description: Percent of width removed from the left.

direction.description: Direction of travel for wipe, push and fly.
